metadata.title: Barley NIR acquisition-stage benchmark: dish-grouped nested validation and revision diagnostics
metadata.description: Reproducibility package for a public barley NIR acquisition-stage benchmark. Includes executable code, a result-reading notebook, per-observation out-of-fold predictions, candidate-level internal search tables, partition and exploratory domain-transfer checks, training-only PLS VIP and coefficient profiles, frozen C=100/300/1000 SVR checks, software versions and SHA-256 manifests. Original all-stage nested SVR MAE is 0.576962; its saved post-moisture predictions have MAE 0.680003. Stage and acquisition session coincide in one exposure sequence, so session fingerprinting cannot be excluded. Added C diagnostics never select a replacement primary model from outer errors. Source and data-bearing components retain applicable CC BY-NC 4.0 attribution and non-commercial requirements; independently authored software licensing is a separate rights decision. See RIGHTS_AND_LICENSES.md.

required_before_use: Confirm creators, order, affiliations and ORCIDs with all authors.
Confirm software rights and license; retain source-license notices and separately identify data-bearing components.
Review whether to deposit source spectra or instead link to the ERDA record.
Confirm public-deposit authorization and review manuscript/congress requirements.
Create a draft record; a reserved DOI alone is not proof of a published deposit.
Publish only after author approval, verify the published version DOI and insert it in the manuscript.
